lines.zh: 我每跳一下都留下焦印。
lines.en: Every hop I take leaves a scorch mark.
Sparks jump where I land.
Lava drips off me as I go.
I flow right across a lava pool.
A burning trail drags from my lower half.
Each hop flattens the cinders.
I hop across the nether's barrens.
The heat makes the air shimmer.
My body pulses with light.

lines.zh: 每次落地都像砸了一下。
lines.en: Every landing feels like a blow.
I hop my way onto higher ground.
Red light falls on the stones around.
I settle and spread out on the ground.
The lava inside me turns slowly.
I'm scorching the dry grass beside me.
I'm quite used to the heat here.
The surface of me keeps bubbling.
My body wobbles gently.
I lie by the magma, bubbling.
The stones under me glow red.

lines.zh: 岩浆滴成一小小的一坑。
lines.en: Drops of lava form a little pool.
Doing nothing, I still don't cool.

lines.zh: 你站到了我烤热的范围。
lines.en: You've stepped into my scorched range.
You feel the heat as you near me.
I turn slowly toward your side.
Fire runs inside this body of mine.
The stone by your feet is glowing.
Those boots will get burnt through.

lines.zh: 我们之间隔着一片热浪。
lines.en: A wall of heat lies between us.
I'm almost at your feet.
The light makes your face go red.
I edge toward you bit by bit.
My whole body rocked.

lines.zh: 我的形状被打散了一点。
lines.en: My shape got scattered a little.
A gout of fire splashed out.
I gathered myself back together.
That dimmed me a little.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖身上剩下的火。
lines.en: I shook off what fire I had left.
There are more scorch marks on the ground.
I flared up a bit hotter.
I haven't come apart at all.
Being hit like this doesn't frighten me.
That would melt the moment I touched it.

lines.zh: 这玩意儿我烧了也不吃。
lines.en: I'd burn this stuff and still not eat it.
Your hand isn't burning holding that?
It would catch fire this close.

lines.zh: 我的身体会把金属熔掉。
lines.en: My body would melt metal.
You'd better set it further off.

lines.zh: 这东西我碰一下就没了。
lines.en: One touch and it would be gone.
There's nothing here I want to eat.
I shifted slowly to one side.
That little bit isn't enough for me.
The heat made you jump away.
The stones creaked under my weight.

lines.zh: 你撞上来的一下我全接住。
lines.en: I absorbed that bump entirely.
I left a scorch mark on the ground.
Your soles must be hurting.
I wobbled twice and settled.
That didn't even scatter my shape.
Sparks landed on your trouser leg.
The heat wave pushed you back.
I slowly spread myself flat.
We're both made of fire.
Too close and we'd melt together.
The fire in you is dimmer than mine.
Let's keep this lava pool together.
Neither of us fears the heat.
I'll shift a little toward you.
Two fires together burn brighter.
There's room here for us both.
Don't carry off a piece of me.
Let's just burn quietly like this.
It melted the moment I touched it.
I wrapped it inside my body.

lines.zh: 我把这东西裹进身体里。
lines.en: I wrap the thing into my body.
It went soft inside me.
Your thing fell into the lava.

lines.zh: 我用身体把它滚着带走。
lines.en: I roll it along inside my body.
It rolled over on my surface.
I spat it back out.
The iron glowed red and then was gone.
This stone will burn for a long while.
You're standing in front of me.
I start hopping toward you.
My body has grown very bright.
A string of fire marks my path.

lines.zh: 你退得再远，我都能烧到。
lines.en: However far you back off, I'll still burn you.
My temperature is still rising.
I've marked off this direction.
The ground by your feet is heating.
One hop brings me to your feet.
Do you hear that hissing sound?
My heat has already closed over you.
This landing will come down hard.
Dodging won't help you at all.
I've landed on your shadow.
This time I'm hopping faster.
Here I am right now.

lines.zh: 我在地面上一跳一跳追。
lines.en: I chase along the ground, hop by hop.
A line of scorch marks trails behind.
You've gone around that heap of stone.
Stone won't stop my heat.
I'm closing the distance slowly.

lines.zh: 你踩过的地方还在冒烟。
lines.en: Where you stepped is still smoking.
My hops are bringing me closer.
Sweat is starting on your brow.
My body has brightened another shade.
I hear your breathing tighten.
You've been pressed to the rock's foot.

lines.zh: 我把这条道堵成一片火。
lines.en: I clog this passage into a wall of fire.
I'm about to make another hop.
The heat has risen again.
You've raised a hand to shield your face.
I'm nearly at your feet.
I press against your leg.
The burn made you recoil hard.
My whole body lands on your foot.
Magma splashes out as I press down.
I've softened the iron plates on you.

lines.zh: 你跳开的时候还在冒烟。
lines.en: You jumped away still smoking.
A little lava splashed off me.
There's nowhere to dodge fire.
I bounced up again.
That wasn't my hottest.
I pulled back half a step to gather.
Your skin has gone red.
I'm ready to press down again.
Climbing higher won't dodge my fire.
I rise up out of the lava.
The nether floor is a dim red.
Sparks dance all around me.
Landing, I scorched the ground.
My body is still taking shape.
The heat here suits me exactly.
Lava bubbles in the distance.

lines.zh: 我从岩浆坑里慢慢拱起。
lines.en: I slowly rise out of the magma pit.
Fire drips from me as I move.
The ground cracks where I land.
I start hopping forward slowly.

lines.zh: 我闻到热气里有活人味。
lines.en: I smell a living creature in the heat.
Fire means nothing to me.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下来，溅得满地。
lines.en: I fell from a height and splashed everywhere.
Water hisses on my body.
The blast threw me far.
The arrow melted as it entered.

lines.zh: 那光让我的火冷了一瞬。
lines.en: That light cooled my fire for an instant.
My fire is getting smaller.

lines.zh: 雷电落下来，我亮得发白。
lines.en: Lightning struck and I flared white.
No ground below; I'm falling.
